## About
The One Auto Service and Performance is a full repair shop on Lisbon St in Daly City. We work on all makes and models, foreign and domestic, from Audi, BMW and Porsche to Honda, Toyota, Ford and Jeep.
Along with everyday repairs, we install aftermarket performance parts and work on lowered vehicles. Lowering springs, coilovers, intake and exhaust are all on our list.
We keep a clean working area, and you can wait in our waiting room with a television and free wifi. We're rated 4.2 on Google from 55 reviews.

## Services
- Smog Check: Smog check with the certificate included. ($75 including certificate)
- Aftermarket performance parts installation: Lowering springs, full coilovers with height adjustment, camber kits, intake, header, exhaust, turbo and supercharger work. One reviewer had an aftermarket steering wheel installed on a Challenger Scat Pack.
- Oil Changes: For Porsche, Mercedes, Mini, BMW, Audi, Honda, Toyota, Nissan, Lexus, Ford, Jeep and more.
- Brake Service: Along with brake fluid flush, brake drum adjustment and master cylinder replacement.
- Check Engine Light Diagnostic: Find out what that light means before it turns into something bigger.
- Timing Belt Replacement: Part of our engine work, along with coolant flush, tune-ups, valve adjustment and compression tests.
- Full vehicle inspection before purchase: Have a car looked over before you buy it. We also do inspections for road trips or routine maintenance.
- Electrical Diagnostic: We also install dash cams, audio and back up cameras.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my car?
A: We work on all makes and models, foreign and domestic, from Audi, BMW, Mercedes Benz and Volvo to Honda, Toyota, Hyundai, Kia, Ford, Chevy and Jeep.

Q: Can I get a quote online?
A: Yes. Online quotes are welcome, or you can call or email us anytime.

Q: How do you price repairs?
A: Prices vary from vehicle to vehicle, so give us a call for an estimate.

Q: Do you work on lowered cars?
A: Yes, we work on lowered vehicles. One reviewer's car was too low for our alignment, so we tried a friend's shop for them too.

## What customers say
- "We were looking to buy a car remotely from a local dealership, and asked The One Auto Service to do a pre-inspection for us.  Most other local mechanics wanted $120-$180 (3x the national average), and many weren't available.  The One Auto Service was the only place that offered a reasonable price of $80, and was willing to do it same-day for us.  We really appreciated that.

What we got back from them was fantastic.  They didn't find much in the way of mechanical problems, as the car did only have 13k miles.  But there were a number of paint defects (blemishes, scratches, etc) and The One emailed excellent high resolution, in-focus (which is somehow a rarity these days) photos of each and every blemish, from an angle and with lighting that showed it clearly so that we could make an informed decision.  We also got quantified measurements (not just "looks good") of each tire's tread and brake life.

In the end we decided to purchase a different car from another state, in excellent condition.  The One Auto Service helped save us from an unhappy purchase that we would have been reminded of every time we looked at our car for years.  I highly recommend them, and am glad there are competent businesses that can do their job well and don't need babysat to get it done.

Thank you The One!" (Nicholas Bostaph, 5/5)

They were so nice and explained to me the likely cause of the error, what I could do in the meantime, and future options to resolve the issue. They gave me confidence to continue on the rest of my drive and everything they said checked out later when I had a chance to do more research." (Genee Lee, 5/5)
